correctness.rationale: The phase-average tiling identity and exact convolution integral give the piecewise rational Fisher objective without approximation. Its derivative numerator is an explicit strictly decreasing quadratic on 0<x<=1 and a strictly decreasing cubic on x>=1 with matching sign at 1; this proves exactly one global maximum. Implicit differentiation proves both strict comparative statics, and limiting polynomial roots give the sharp asymptotics. The standalone checker passed 2283 numerical and symbolic tests, supplemental to the complete analytic argument.

value.rationale: The exposure-to-transit duration decision is a natural observable design parameter, not an arbitrary invariant. The exact boundary h>(1+3r)/(1-r) shows where extreme overhead can reverse the usual preference for sub-transit exposures; the additional finite-versus-diverging high-overhead result separates measurements with even a weak independent floor from the photon-only ideal. The complete unique optimizer is directly reproducible as a quantitative test case when evaluating more realistic cadence models. This is a structural benchmark and does not claim real telescope prescriptions.
